title: Training army intelligence officers in remote viewing

tellings.quote: well the reason i stopped was i was already working uh frankly 24 hours a day on on training the army intelligence officers

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff says he once spent nearly all his time training US Army intelligence officers in remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe distant places or things using the mind alone. He tells it on the show as the reason he stopped doing other work, saying he was busy "24 hours a day" with the training. If true, it means the Army took the method seriously enough to teach it to its own officers.
